payload.householdScope: Major remaining durable and countertop household-appliance purchase journeys with exact manufacturer configuration identity; not an exhaustive list of appliances sold in Türkiye.

existingCategories.authorityRule: No existing Product semantics, catalog membership, Domain Pack, Y authority, active pointer, route, UI, production data or deployment is changed by this release.

platformBoundaries.domainPackRule: Each selected category requires its own versioned semantic authority; existing-six meanings are not reusable domain semantics.

stages.x: Education and explanation only; no candidate selection authority.
stages.p: AŞAMA 1 category-specific need capture and exact-evidence decision only.
stages.y: Category-specific decision construction/authorization to be defined later; this portfolio grants none.
stages.stage2: Future Advisor and paid comparison may read only an authorized AŞAMA 1 exact set and may not alter Y.
stages.stage3: Future commerce/contact handoff remains separate and cannot become recommendation authority.

platformBoundaries.evidenceTemporality: Technical facts and manuals are frozen with checksum, market, model/configuration and locator applicability. Price, stock, offers and media are volatile exact-identity joins outside the catalog digest.
platformBoundaries.selectionPolicy: No score, weight, ranking, question policy, sufficiency rule or recommendation policy is authorized here. Unknown evidence remains neutral and non-advantaging.

categories.decisionObject: One exact Türkiye household freezer configuration; upright/chest, freestanding/built-in are explicit configuration attributes.
categories.excluded: Commercial cold rooms, display freezers and refrigerator freezer compartments.
categories.separationRationale: Long-term frozen storage, capacity, footprint, defrost and outage behavior differ from refrigerator decisions.

categories.decisionObject: One exact Türkiye built-in oven configuration and required cabinet envelope.
categories.included: Full-size and compact built-in ovens; microwave-combination capability is an attribute only when the product remains manufacturer-taxonomized as an oven.
categories.excluded: Freestanding cookers, countertop ovens and standalone microwaves.
categories.separationRationale: Cabinet cut-out, electrical connection, cavity, cleaning and cooking modes form a distinct installed decision.

categories.decisionObject: One exact freestanding household cooker combining hob and oven in one manufacturer configuration.
categories.included: Full-size freestanding gas/electric mixed or electric cookers.
categories.excluded: Built-in ovens, separate hobs, mini/midi countertop ovens and commercial ranges.
categories.separationRationale: A combined fuel, connection, footprint and cavity purchase cannot inherit built-in oven or hob semantics.

categories.decisionObject: One exact built-in hob configuration, including fuel/technology and cut-out envelope.
categories.included: Gas, radiant-electric, induction and manufacturer-defined integrated-extraction hobs.
categories.excluded: Freestanding cookers and portable single burners.
categories.separationRationale: Fuel, electrical/gas installation, cut-out and cookware compatibility are primary decision semantics.

categories.decisionObject: One exact household extraction appliance plus installation mode and duct/recirculation configuration.
categories.included: Wall, island, integrated and under-cabinet hoods/aspirators.
categories.excluded: Integrated-extraction hobs as standalone hoods and commercial ventilation.
categories.separationRationale: Airflow, ducting, recirculation kit, width, noise and installation evidence are independent from the cooking appliance.

categories.included: Solo countertop microwave appliances, with grill/convection recorded as exact capabilities.
categories.excluded: Built-in microwaves and oven products with an integrated microwave function.
categories.separationRationale: No cabinet cut-out or fitted-installation dependency; placement and usable volume dominate.

categories.decisionObject: One exact fitted microwave configuration and cabinet niche.
categories.excluded: Countertop microwaves and built-in ovens whose microwave is only one cooking capability.
categories.separationRationale: Niche geometry, ventilation and installation compatibility make substitution with countertop models unsafe.

categories.decisionObject: One exact residential single-split indoor/outdoor unit set for a declared room and installation context.
categories.included: Residential wall-mounted single-split heat-pump air conditioners.
categories.excluded: Multi-split, salon, cassette, ducted, VRF/system and portable units; commercial sizing.
categories.separationRationale: Capacity sizing, paired-unit identity, climate rating, noise and mandatory installation require a dedicated decision object.

categories.decisionObject: One exact portable household air-cleaner configuration for a declared room/use context.
categories.excluded: HVAC-integrated systems, humidifiers/dehumidifiers and medical outcome claims.
categories.separationRationale: CADR/room-size, filter system, noise and replacement-filter lifecycle differ from air-conditioning semantics.

categories.decisionObject: One exact bean-to-cup household espresso configuration.
categories.excluded: Built-in coffee systems, capsule systems, filter and Turkish coffee machines.
categories.separationRationale: Integrated grinder, drink automation, milk system and maintenance workflow are defining needs.

categories.decisionObject: One exact portafilter-based household espresso configuration.
categories.included: Manual and semi-automatic portafilter machines; grinder inclusion is explicit.
categories.excluded: Bean-to-cup, capsule, filter and Turkish coffee machines.
categories.separationRationale: User skill/control, grinder, portafilter, steam and workflow create a distinct purchase journey.

categories.decisionObject: One exact drip/filter coffee appliance configuration.
categories.excluded: Espresso, capsule, pod and Turkish coffee machines; standalone grinders.
categories.separationRationale: Batch volume, carafe, keep-warm and brewing workflow are not espresso semantics.

categories.decisionObject: One exact electric Turkish-coffee appliance configuration.
categories.excluded: Stovetop pots, espresso and filter machines.
categories.separationRationale: Cup/pot capacity, overflow control and Turkish-coffee workflow form a locally material distinct journey.

categories.decisionObject: One exact countertop hot-air cooking appliance configuration.
categories.included: Single/dual-basket household hot-air fryers and manufacturer-defined multicook variants where hot-air cooking is primary.
categories.excluded: Built-in ovens, pressure cookers, contact grills and generic small cooking appliances.
categories.separationRationale: Basket topology, usable capacity, synchronization, footprint and cleaning have coherent evidence and needs.

categories.decisionObject: One exact jug or personal blender configuration; form factor is explicit.
categories.included: Countertop jug and personal smoothie blenders.
categories.excluded: Hand blenders, food processors, stand mixers, juicers and catch-all food-preparation bundles.
categories.separationRationale: Vessel, blade, usable volume and hot/ice suitability create a bounded comparable object.

categories.decisionObject: One exact bowl-based food processor configuration with its included attachment set frozen as identity.
categories.included: Bowl food processors marketed as mutfak robotu.
categories.excluded: Blenders, hand blenders, stand mixers, choppers and changing accessory bundles not bound to an exact SKU.
categories.separationRationale: Attachment-set identity, bowl capacity and preparation operations materially differ from blender decisions.

categories.decisionObject: One exact electric storage water-heater configuration plus household installation envelope.
categories.excluded: Instantaneous heaters, heat-pump tanks, boilers/combis and gas appliances.
categories.separationRationale: Stored volume, recovery, pressure, corrosion protection, wet-area electrical and plumbing constraints require separate safety-aware semantics.

categories.decisionObject: One exact electric instantaneous household water-heater configuration plus declared electrical/plumbing installation envelope.
categories.included: Electric instantaneous shower/tap water heaters supported in the current TR manufacturer channel.
categories.excluded: Gas/hermetic heaters, storage tanks, combis and commercial systems.
categories.separationRationale: Flow, input power, circuit and instantaneous delivery are incompatible with storage-heater comparison.

familyRules.rule: Shared navigation only; oven, cooker, hob and hood remain separate Domain Packs and decision objects.
Built-in and countertop remain separate due to non-substitutable installation identity.
No COFFEE_MACHINE catch-all runtime category; preparation workflow defines four separate categories.
No SMALL_KITCHEN_APPLIANCE catch-all; only air fryer, blender and food processor are frozen now.
Storage and instantaneous electric systems remain separate; gas systems are excluded.

deferred.reason: Different placement/exhaust/noise semantics and thin current exact-TR breadth; reassess after split AC.
Site design and installer-led multi-zone system, not a bounded single household product decision.
Valid but narrow installed niche; defer until built-in cooking foundations exist.
Machine choice is inseparable from proprietary capsule ecosystem and recurring commerce authority not yet governed.
Bundle/accessory identity churn is high; exact-SKU evidence model must be proven with FOOD_PROCESSOR first.
Attachment ecosystems and bundle identity need separate accessory governance.
Household-relevant but lower-complexity journey; not required for this major-category portfolio.
Major garment-care family, but outside the bounded kitchen/climate/storage/hot-water expansion and requires its own split analysis.
Filter subscription, water-quality claims, installation and service lifecycle require separate commercial/safety authority.
Distinct indoor-air and health-claim semantics; not to be folded into AIR_PURIFIER.
Separate countertop thermal-cooking identity; defer rather than merge with built-in oven or cooker.

excluded.scope: Commercial/industrial appliances, cold rooms, VRF, commercial kitchen and laundry
Gas/hermetic water heaters, boilers and combis
excluded.reason: Combustion, regulated installation and heating-system semantics require a separate safety and service program.

excluded.scope: Generic OTHER_APPLIANCES, SMALL_KITCHEN_APPLIANCE or COFFEE_MACHINE IDs
excluded.reason: Catch-alls conflate incompatible evidence and decision semantics.

excluded.scope: Services, installation providers, consumables, spare parts and accessories as products
excluded.reason: May be evidence or commerce dependencies but are not product candidates in this authority.

excluded.scope: Televisions, personal electronics and smart-home hubs
excluded.reason: Not Appliances purchase objects in this bounded portfolio.

domainPackAuthorityGaps: A category-specific concept and terminology registry for every selected ID.
Exact configuration identity rules, including bundle/accessory and paired-unit identity where applicable.
Official-source acceptance, conflict, supersession, applicability and checksum rules specialized only where needed.
Category-specific technical fact units/regimes and same-scope comparability dimensions.
Category-specific need-to-evidence mappings and hard-constraint materiality definitions.
Question, sufficiency, candidate evaluation, Pareto/tie and Y construction/authorization policies.
Safety and installation boundary for gas/electrical/plumbing/high-heat and indoor-air claims.
Manual L9 promotion rules and read-only Advisor/paid-comparison projections.
Volatile price/media/offer freshness and exact-identity join contracts.

implementationBatches.objective: Extend TypeScript/DB/route/registry constraints in one additive multi-category foundation; create inactive Domain Pack slots and fail-closed loaders only.
implementationBatches.gate: No category becomes runtime active and no catalog member is created.

implementationBatches.rationale: High official evidence availability; establishes cold-storage and installed-cooking identity/installation patterns.
Proves fitted-vs-portable separation, paired-unit identity and indoor-air claim boundaries.
One evidence-acquisition family but four non-conflated preparation workflows.
Introduces countertop and attachment-bound identity without a catch-all.
Last because electrical/plumbing safety and installation evidence are release blockers.

nextWorkUnit.objective: Implement only the additive shared foundation for all frozen category IDs, including constraints, inactive registry capability records, schema/loader contracts and fail-closed tests; do not create catalogs, category semantics, runtime activation, UI journeys or production members.
